headline: Sensex and Nifty reverse early gains in volatile Muhurat Trading to mark Samvat 2083

marketStatus.message: Today is Diwali Laxmi Pujan. NSE will conduct Muhurat Trading. Exact trading timings are notified separately by NSE.

why: Dalal Street conducted the special Muhurat Trading session on Diwali Laxmi Pujan to kick off Samvat 2083.
Early session buying momentum faded as indices reversed initial gains of nearly 400 points.
Bharti Airtel and Infosys weighed on the benchmarks as top losers.
India VIX jumped 6% as markets ended lower, snapping a seven-day rally.
whatHappening: Sensex initially surged around 400 points before giving up gains to end flat to lower.
Nifty briefly crossed 25,100 early in the session before closing below the 25,000 mark.
Bharti Airtel and Infosys were among the key drag stocks on the market during Muhurat trading.
Gold and silver outlook remains focused on US-Iran tensions and global inflation data next week.
summary: Indian stock markets held the special Muhurat Trading session to usher in Samvat 2083 on Diwali Laxmi Pujan. Despite early gains surging nearly 400 points, indices reversed course to close flat to lower with India VIX rising 6%. Bharti Airtel and Infosys featured among the top losers of the session.
